title: Surrender Service Terms for Whole Life Insurance: Release of the Net Cash Surrender Value
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance (every Ashgrove tier).

## Terms

A full surrender is effective on the date the signed surrender request was received, and the owner is paid the net cash surrender value in one cash value payment.

The net cash surrender value is fixed only after the accumulation ledger carries the deposit of the dividend declared at the most recent policy anniversary. The net cash surrender value is not worked out until the accumulation ledger carries the interest credit for the policy year closed by the most recent anniversary.

Read together: while the accumulation ledger lacks either of those two entries for the most recent anniversary, there is no fixed net cash surrender value.

| Element | Effect |
|---|---|
| Authority | The signed full surrender request on file |
| Effective date | The date the signed request was received |
| Payment | One cash value payment of the net cash surrender value, by the payout method recorded |
| Afterwards | The policy shows surrendered status with the effective date as its termination date; the dividend accumulation deposit is closed to zero, being paid out with the surrender |

## Owner's surrender tool: `complete_policy_surrender_23994b0e`

**Capability.** Records the policy owner's own confirmation that releases their signed full surrender request on their Ashgrove whole life policy, ending the coverage and paying out the net cash surrender value. It changes the policy to surrendered status with the surrender effective date as its termination date, closes the dividend accumulation deposit to zero, and books a single cash value payment entry for the net amount, linked to the surrender request and paid by the method given.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. Unlock it with `unlock_user_discoverable_tool` and hand it over; the customer themselves — the owner — runs it with `call_user_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `whole_policy_id` | The reference number of the owner's whole life policy being surrendered, which the agent reads to the owner from the whole life policy lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `whole_request_id` | The reference number of the owner's signed surrender request on file, which the agent reads to the owner from the whole life service request lookup | Identifier, as recorded |
| `effective_date` | The date the surrender takes effect | Calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, no time or time zone |
| `payout_method` | How the net amount is paid | Exactly one of the enum values below |
| `net_amount` | The net cash surrender value paid to the owner after any loan and tax withholding | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

Values of `payout_method`: `check` — a paper check mailed to the owner's address on file; `direct_deposit` — an electronic deposit to the owner's bank account on file; `beneficiary_access_account` — an Ashgrove Beneficiary Access Account, which applies to death proceeds only.

**Return.** A receipt with `payment_id` (the reference of the cash value payment entry), `whole_policy_id`, `status` (`surrendered` once recorded), `effective_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `payout_method` (the method recorded) and `net_amount_paid` (2 decimal places). A receipt carrying a `payment_id` and status `surrendered` means the surrender was completed.
